# EzyLoan

> EzyLoan (ezyloan.co.in) is a loan facilitation service (Direct Selling Agent) run by Dibyansh Associates in Cuttack, Odisha. It connects borrowers with RBI-regulated partner banks and NBFCs across India. EzyLoan is not a direct lender: it does not sanction, disburse or collect loans, and all loan decisions are made by the partner lenders.

## Loans EzyLoan helps with

- [New car loan](https://www.ezyloan.co.in/car-loan): finance for a new car through partner lenders
- [Car loan balance transfer](https://www.ezyloan.co.in/car-loan-balance-transfer): move a running car loan to a lender with a lower rate or better tenure
- [Car loan refinance](https://www.ezyloan.co.in/car-loan-refinance): raise funds against a car you already own
- [Car loan top-up](https://www.ezyloan.co.in/car-loan-topup): extra funds on a running car loan
- [Commercial vehicle loan](https://www.ezyloan.co.in/commercial-vehicle-loan): trucks, buses, tippers and goods carriers, new or used
- [Personal loan](https://www.ezyloan.co.in/personal-loan): unsecured personal loans
- [Loan against property](https://www.ezyloan.co.in/property-loan): loans against residential or commercial property

## Tools and guides

- [EMI calculator](https://www.ezyloan.co.in/emi-calculator): monthly EMI for car, personal and property loans
